title: Messages that survive a dropped connection
notes: Messages no longer go missing when the connection drops. The app confirms each one and sends it again if needed.
Faster: the Today screen opens from cache, and chats load and scroll more quickly.
Read vault notes inside the app, even when Obsidian doesn't have that vault.
Copy, share or save pictures in replies. They stay after a relaunch.
Add a contact straight from a scanned business card.
Tighter security: every connection needs its token, and pairing links ask before they apply.

title: First release on the App Store
notes: FieldADE is on the App Store. It reaches the assistants on your Mac from your iPhone.
